title: MAS-Guard: Unified Guardrails from Individual Agents to Multi-Agent LLM Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.28397v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic AI extends large language models (LLMs) from generating responses to planning and executing complex workflows, substantially expanding their utility while exposing applications to unsafe actions, information leakage, and adversarial manipulation. Multi-agent systems further expand these capabilities through specialization and collaboration, but distributed authority, heterogeneous roles, and opaque or potentially compromised participants make safeguarding even more challenging. Existing defenses address important individual threats but provide fragmented coverage across local execution, system-level interactions, and enforcement mechanisms. We introduce MAS-Guard, a unified framework that closes this gap for safeguarding single- and multi-agent AI applications containing both instrumentable and opaque agents. Within instrumentable agents, the proposed local Agent Guardrail (A-Guard) layer applies task-specific experts to assess

translated_title: MAS-Guard：从单个智能体到多智能体大语言模型系统的统一防护框架
translated_abstract: 智能体AI将大语言模型（LLM）从生成响应扩展到规划与执行复杂工作流，在大幅提升其效用的同时，也使应用面临不安全行为、信息泄露和对抗性操纵等风险。多智能体系统通过专业化分工与协作进一步扩展了这些能力，但权限分散、角色异构以及参与者不透明或可能已被攻陷等因素，使得安全防护变得更具挑战性。现有防御手段虽能应对重要的单一威胁，但在本地执行、系统级交互和执行机制方面的覆盖是碎片化的。我们提出MAS-Guard，这是一个统一框架，为包含可插桩智能体和不透明智能体的单智能体及多智能体AI应用提供安全保障，填补了这一空白。在可插桩智能体中，所提出的本地智能体防护层（A-Guard）应用任务特定的专家来评估……
tldr: 该论文提出统一安全防护框架MAS-Guard，通过本地智能体防护层（A-Guard）等机制，为包含可插桩与不透明智能体的单智能体和多智能体LLM系统，提供覆盖本地执行与系统级交互的一体化安全保障。
en_tdlr: MAS-Guard is a unified guardrail framework that safeguards both single- and multi-agent LLM systems—covering instrumentable and opaque agents alike—by closing the gap between fragmented defenses across local execution, system-level interactions, and enforcement mechanisms.
